IGUI_PD_BreedDesc_blueheeler: A tough Australian cattle dog. Learns herding and obedience fast, holds its own in a fight, and works the stock without wearing you out. Strays turn up around barns and farmsteads, and rarely in houses.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_CattleDrive_desc: Your Blue Heeler works the stock with you. While it stays close, fed and loyal, livestock settle down and you tire more slowly.
